title: A form cannot fill a field from a picked lookup record (declared lookup-pick autofill)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27434 said: triage rows 1–7, TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `e41642dd` (report 6515174308, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: any record form with a lookup whose pick should fill a sibling field. HotCRM quote line item: product → `unit_price`.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the declaration), then `domain:ui` (the form's lookup widget honours it).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "lookup pick autofill copy field from picked lookup record in form" → #26951 and #25860, both closed and about other lookup gaps.

## Observed
Picking a lookup in a record form fills nothing else. A quote line's Sales Price arrives only after save, from a server hook. The only autofill today is the line-item grid column key `autofill` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`). It is on by default and copies same-named fields, but in the grid only.

## Wanted
A declared lookup-pick autofill on the form or the field (`target ← lookup.field`). The spec half is the declaration and its docs. The ui half (a follow-up `domain:ui` card) is the form lookup widget (`LookupField` / the form renderer) writing the declared targets on pick. Keep the rule that an author's own value is never overwritten without saying so.

Dedupe words: lookup autofill form, copy fields from lookup, lookup pick fill, unit_price from product.

Related: #27434 (row 3).
